author: Tioga County NY Daily Brief
title: 🚨 Tioga County Sheriff Reports 3 March Arrests - NewsBreak
text:
15 hours ago The Tioga County Sheriff’s Office shared three recent arrests:
• March 16, 2026 – Mark K. Brown , 58, from Owego, was charged with Criminal Mischief in the 3rd Degree after an investigation found several vehicle windows had been broken. He was arraigned in CAP Court and taken to the Tioga County Jail.
• February 28, 2026 – Kelsey Jo Bean , 23, from Berkshire, was charged with Driving While Intoxicated and Driving While Intoxicated .08 or higher after a traffic stop. She was released with an appearance ticket and will appear in Town of Owego Court .
• March 12, 2026 – Ian Brenchley , 40, from Binghamton, was arrested on a Bench Warrant for several drug possession charges and Bail Jumping in the 2nd Degree . He was arraigned in CAP Court and Tioga County Court, with bail set at $10,000/$15,000 and $5,000/$10,000 respectively.
Approved by Captain Yaeger and posted March 18, 2026 .
More Info: http://www.tiogacountysheriff.com/usr/Press%20Rele...
